evals.prompt: example.org says their site was slow and throwing errors in the last 3 hours. Can you check the deflect logs and tell me what happened?
evals.expected_output: Uses osq.sh on deflect.log-* filtered by client_request_host (not host), bounded to 3h, size 0 with a date_histogram and status-code breakdown; reports 5xx timing, upstream/origin vs edge, times in UTC.

evals.prompt: who is hammering www.example.org right now? top IPs, countries and ASNs from the last 30 min, and did banjax ban any of them
evals.expected_output: Aggregates client_ip, geoip.country_code2, geoip.as_org on deflect.log-* for 30m with a host filter, then checks banjax-* for the same host and window by rule_type/trigger; checks the www/apex variant; summarises without dumping raw logs.

evals.prompt: Did Baskerville send any commands for 203.0.113.10 today, and why?
evals.expected_output: Queries baskerville_banjax_command-* for today matching client_ip OR value for the IP; groups by source and baskerville_command; explains the reason from source; notes block_guard rewrites if blocks appear as challenges.

evals.prompt: how many bans did banjax issue across all sites in the last 2 days?
evals.expected_output: Recognises 2 days > 1 day needs a query condition besides time (for example rule_type in regex/failed_challenge) and runs it with that condition.

evals.prompt: pull the traffic for example.org for the whole of last month so I can put it in the quarterly report
evals.expected_output: Refuses any single query over 7 days and does not try to bypass the guard; offers a narrower window or a series of per-week queries.
